text: 1.Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens and meet the requirements stipulated in the Ministry of Education's Document No. 12 of 2020. The applicant is in good physical and mental health and willing to abide by the laws and regulations of China as well as the rules and regulations of Wuhan University.2. Applicants must be between 18 and 25 years old, with age calculated as of September 1st of the year of enrollment. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit a guardian's guarantee letter at the time of application.3. Language proficiencyApplicants for Chinese-taught courses must have a Chinese proficiency of 180 points (inclusive) or above on the New HSK Level 4. Applicants whose native language is Chinese or who were taught in Chinese during high school, upon recognition by our school, may be exempted from providing HSK scores.Applicants for courses taught in English are required to have an English proficiency of TOEFL 80+, TOEFL Essential 8+ or IELTS 6.0+. Applicants whose native language is English or whose previous academic qualifications were taught in English, upon recognition by our university, may be exempted from providing TOEFL and IELTS scores
